fields.Problem description: Determine the integers $n \ge 2$ for which a set of $n$ points in the Euclidean plane, with no three collinear and no four concyclic, realizes exactly $n-1$ distinct distances whose multiplicities are $1,2,\ldots,n-1$, each occurring once. Multiplicity counts unordered pairs of distinct points; the distances need not be ordered by size. Such a set is called a crescent configuration. Erdős conjectured that no such configurations exist for all sufficiently large $n$.
fields.Publication details:

fields.Problem description: Determine the maximum chromatic number f(n) of a triangle-free graph on n vertices, or inversely the minimum order h₃(k) of a triangle-free graph with chromatic number k. Find precise asymptotics; the minimum-order formulation also asks whether h₃(k+1)/h₃(k) tends to one.
